description: LC4's cancel on a finished loop (S55 T5): a terminal loop has no control to apply, and the refusal names the state it found (data.kind 'terminal', the status in the what) instead of pretending the cancel happened — a cancel that 'succeeds' on a done loop would write an abort event for work that is already over, which the audit must not do.

params.reason: the loop is finished — cancel the rest

error.message: the loop control refused the operation

data.what: loop cancel refused: the loop is done — it has no control to apply
data.means: the daemon understood and declined — nothing was written and nothing moved
